topic: Money market funds and high-yield savings pay similar rates but one is FDIC-insured and one isn't
title: That 'Safe' Account Can Still Lose Money
description:
High-yield savings accounts and money market funds often have similar interest rates. But one is insured by the government, and one is an investment that can lose value. Know the difference before you park your cash.
